about.heroText: LuxMeble began in a small Kraków workshop with a simple idea: let people design exactly the piece they want, then build it by hand — only once it’s theirs.
about.storyP1: Mass-produced furniture fills warehouses, then landfills. We flipped the model: you configure a piece in real-time 3D, and only then do our makers begin. The result is furniture that fits your room and your taste exactly — with far less waste along the way.
about.storyP2: Every order is traceable from our bench to your door, and most parts can be re-ordered years later. That’s what made-to-order should mean.

madeToOrder.title: Made to order
madeToOrder.desc: Nothing sits in a warehouse. Every piece is built only after you configure it — your fabric, your finish, your size.

honestMaterials.title: Honest materials
honestMaterials.desc: Kiln-dried hardwood frames, full-grain leather and European-milled fabrics. We tell you exactly what’s inside.

builtToLast.title: Built to last
builtToLast.desc: A 10-year frame warranty and parts you can re-order years later. Furniture should outlive trends.
